description: Tempo time tracking. Actions: start, stop, current (the running entry, if any), entries_list, entry_create (manual entry), entry_update, entry_delete, summary.

days.description: How many days back to list — entries_list (default 7, 1-90).

entry_id.description: Time entry id — required for entry_update/entry_delete.

item_id.description: Life item_id this time is logged against — start/entry_create/entry_update.

started_at.description: Start timestamp (ISO 8601) — required for entry_create; entry_update.

stopped_at.description: Stop timestamp (ISO 8601) — required for entry_create; entry_update.

name: mind_timer
